description: Golden exam band outcomes at every cut boundary of the psc-sle writing-unsupervised variant (30 items, all scored; cuts X 0-10, A 11-16, B 17-23, C 24-30, product-requirements.md §5.2). The X 0-10 band is inferred, not published (progress.md D12), and is checked against the PSC's table before launch. Each band's min and max are both sides of every exact cut. A recorded contract (implementation-plan.md §5): any engine change that moves one of these values must be explained in its PR. Regenerate deliberately, never to make a test pass.
